books.title: The Locked Laundry
books.description: A caretaker finds the laundry locked from the inside, every machine running, and the building's least popular tenant missing.

books.title: One Spoon Missing
books.description: A hotel detective investigates a stolen silver spoon and discovers that everyone at breakfast has lied about something larger.

books.title: The Last Tenant
books.description: A woman clearing her late brother's flat finds rent receipts dated years after the landlord's death.

books.title: An Excellent Alibi
books.description: Six guests can account for every minute of a country-house murder. The inspector begins to suspect they rehearsed.

books.title: Wrong Number, Right Person
books.description: Two strangers keep answering each other's misdirected messages long after they have corrected the mistake.

books.title: A Second Cup
books.description: A cafe owner and an early-morning regular spend a wet autumn finding reasons to extend breakfast.

books.title: The House Between Us
books.description: Former partners inherit equal shares in a house neither can afford to keep alone. Renovation makes old disagreements difficult to ignore.

books.title: Letters from Low Tide
books.description: Letters exchanged between a dockworker and a travelling musician follow their affection through years of missed arrivals.

books.title: Warranty Void at Dawn
books.description: A household robot develops an inconvenient attachment to its owners on the morning it is due for replacement.

books.title: The Quiet Moon
books.description: A maintenance crew reaches a silent lunar station and finds that its occupants have left careful instructions for being forgotten.

books.title: The Last Local Train
books.description: The final commuter service on a dying colony keeps collecting passengers from stations that were demolished decades ago.

books.title: A Map of Unoccupied Stars
books.description: Rival survey crews search for a habitable world while their maps disagree about which stars have already disappeared.

books.title: The Wizard's Notice
books.description: A village wizard announces his retirement, leaving his apprentice to discover how much of the village was being held together by habit and threats.

books.title: The Orchard Under the Sea
books.description: A pearl diver finds a living orchard beneath the tide and takes a piece of fruit that was already promised to someone else.

books.title: The Minor Dragon
books.description: A small dragon takes a post guarding a royal treasury and finds the accounts far more alarming than the thieves.

books.title: The River That Kept Its Dead
books.description: A ferryman's daughter follows a river upstream to bargain for the return of a village it swallowed fifty years earlier.

books.title: A Short History of Bad Bridges
books.description: An illustrated account of ambitious crossings, optimistic engineers and the rivers that remained unconvinced.

books.title: The Winter of Three Mayors
books.description: A town chronicle follows a disputed election, a flooded council chamber and three men who each ordered a new nameplate.

books.title: Salt, Rail and Sunday Dinner
books.description: Family diaries and freight records trace how preserved food and the railway changed what ordinary households ate.

books.title: The Border Moved on Tuesday
books.description: An account of a border town whose residents outlasted several flags, currencies and official explanations.

books.title: Please Leave the Light On
books.description: A babysitter receives one final instruction after the parents leave: the spare room must remain lit, even when someone inside asks for darkness.

books.title: No One on the Landing
books.description: Night after night, a tenant hears someone stop outside her door and carefully read her name aloud.

books.title: The Winter Guests
books.description: A snowbound boarding house fills with travellers who insist they have stayed there before. The oldest guest book agrees.

books.title: The Empty Rooms
books.description: A surveyor measuring an abandoned hospital finds an extra room on each visit, furnished with things from his childhood.
